summary: US stocks slipped Friday as hot CPI/PPI lifted Fed hike bets and pushed the 10y near 5.17%, hitting Nvidia and gold; the dollar is at a 19-month high with USD/JPY near 160. Weekend Iran claims of tanker mine strikes in Hormuz (disputed by the US) add oil risk. Calendar dataset and Forex Factory were unreadable this run, so tier-1 dates are unverified.
events_next_24h: Mon 13:00 CNY Industrial production & retail sales
Tue (US session) USD Retail sales (date unverified)
Wed ~08:20 USD Nvidia Q3 earnings (Tue after US close)

NQ.why: Hot CPI/PPI lifted Fed hike bets and the 10y to ~5.17%; Nasdaq fell 0.9% Friday on Nvidia; funds 98th-pct long leaves room to unwind.
NQ.risk: Nvidia results (Wed ~8:20am Sydney) beat and calm the CEO worries.

ES.why: Same rate-hike and yield pressure; S&P fell 0.4% Friday though it still notched a winning week; fund positioning is neutral.
ES.risk: Yields fall back or Nvidia reassures the AI trade.

YM.why: Dow held up best (+0.1% Friday) as money rotated out of chips; no fund positioning data for it.
YM.risk: A broad yield-driven sell-off drags value stocks too.

RTY.why: Higher yields hurt small caps, but I couldn't confirm Friday's Russell move or positioning, so no call.
RTY.risk: Clear Russell break with yields pushing higher.

NKD.why: Weak yen helps Japanese exporters but chip stocks and intervention risk cut the other way; funds neutral (46th pct); Japan GDP today.
NKD.risk: Japan intervention (yen jump) or a Nvidia-led chip rally.

6E.why: Fed hike bets and the dollar at a 19-month high weigh on the euro; no positioning data on file.
6E.risk: Soft US data or a hawkish ECB surprise.

6J.why: Yield gap pushes USD/JPY to ~160 (yen weak), but Japan spent a record $50bn defending it and warns again; funds lean long yen (77th).
6J.risk: Intervention would spike 6J up; no action lets it drift lower.

6B.why: Strong dollar on Fed hike bets leans against sterling; UK CPI this week could change that; no positioning data.
6B.risk: Hot UK CPI that boosts BoE hike bets.

6A.why: Risk-off mood and a strong dollar lean against the Aussie; RBA minutes due this week; no positioning data.
6A.risk: China data beat or a risk-on rebound.

ZN.why: CPI and PPI ran hot, Fed hike odds rose, and the 10y hit ~5.17%, highest since October; bond prices fall as yields rise.
ZN.risk: Weak US retail sales or a dovish FOMC minutes read.

GC.why: Gold had a steep weekly loss as yields rose; funds lean short (21st pct), not crowded, so the trend has room but Hormuz is a safe-haven risk.
GC.risk: Hormuz escalation or a fall in real yields.

CL.why: Two weekly losses on surplus talk, but weekend Iran mine claims in Hormuz and funds crowded short (10th pct) raise squeeze risk.
CL.risk: Confirmed Hormuz damage (up) or US clearing the mine claims (down).
